recall.uz: «Shakardan shirin» ertagini tinglab oʻqiymiz va mehnat qadri haqida bilib olamiz.
recall.ru: Слушаем сказку «Слаще сахара» и узнаём о ценности труда.
recall.en: We read the tale “Sweeter than sugar” and learn about the value of work.

props.title: Shakardan shirin
lines: Bir kambagʻal chol bilan kampir yashagan ekan.
Kunlardan bir kun oʻgʻil oʻtin terishga chiqibdi.
U kechgacha tinmay ishlab, juda charchabdi.
Qorni ochib, tugunini ochsa — oddiy zogʻora non.
Nochor yebdi, bu safar non unga juda mazali tuyulibdi.
«Nega bunday?» deb soʻrasa, onasi kulib debdi:

prompt.ru: Послушай и читай, следя за текстом!
prompt.en: Listen and follow along as you read!

hint.en: Why did the bread taste sweet to the son?

explanation.uz: Ertak mehnat bilan topilgan nonning qadri haqida.
explanation.ru: Сказка о ценности хлеба, добытого трудом.
explanation.en: The tale is about the worth of bread earned through work.

text.en: The bread tasted sweet to him

prompt.en: Put the tale's events in the right order!

hint.en: First the son goes for firewood.

explanation.uz: Oʻtinga chiqdi → ishladi → tugunini ochdi → nonni yedi → shirin tuyuldi.
explanation.ru: Пошёл за дровами → работал → развязал узелок → съел хлеб → стало сладко.
explanation.en: Went for wood → worked → opened the bundle → ate the bread → it tasted sweet.

statement.uz: Charchab ishlagach, oddiy non oʻgʻilga juda mazali tuyuldi.
statement.ru: После тяжёлой работы простой хлеб показался сыну вкусным.
statement.en: After hard work, the plain bread tasted delicious to the son.

why.ru: В сказке сказано, что хлеб показался очень вкусным.
why.en: The tale says the bread tasted very good.

hint.en: How does food taste after work?

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri: mehnatdan keyin non shirin tuyuldi.
explanation.ru: Верно: после труда хлеб стал сладким.
explanation.en: True: after work the bread tasted sweet.

statement.en: There was halva in the bundle.

why.uz: Tugunchada holva emas, zogʻora non bor edi.
why.ru: В узелке была не халва, а ячменный хлеб.
why.en: The bundle held barley bread, not halva.

hint.en: What did the son find in the bundle?

explanation.uz: Notoʻgʻri: tugunda zogʻora non bor edi.
explanation.ru: Неверно: в узелке был ячменный хлеб.
explanation.en: False: the bundle held barley bread.

text.uz: Mehnat bilan topilgan non shakardan shirin!
text.en: Bread earned by work is sweeter than sugar!

text.ru: Сегодня я до вечера собирал дрова.
text.en: Today I gathered firewood until evening.

text.uz: Nega bu non bugun juda mazali?
text.ru: Почему этот хлеб сегодня такой вкусный?
text.en: Why is this bread so tasty today?

clue.en: Find the mother's line from the tale.

hint.en: The wise line is said by the mother.

explanation.uz: Hikmatli xulosani ona aytadi, savollarni esa oʻgʻil beradi.
explanation.ru: Вывод произносит мама, а вопросы задаёт сын.
explanation.en: The moral is the mother's; the questions are the son's.

tiles.text: Mehnatli non — shakar, mehnatsiz non — zahar.
Mehnat qilib topganing — qand-u asal totganing.

prompt.ru: Нажми пословицы, подходящие по смыслу к сказке!
prompt.en: Tap the proverbs that fit the tale's meaning!

explanation.uz: Toʻgʻri maqollar mehnat qadrini bildiradi; qolganlari dangasalikni maqtaydi.
explanation.ru: Верные пословицы о ценности труда; остальные хвалят лень.
explanation.en: The right proverbs value work; the others praise laziness.

prompt.en: Match each word to its meaning!

hint.en: “zogʻora non” is baked from corn flour.

explanation.uz: zogʻora non = makkajoʻxori noni; tugun = tugilgan narsa; nochor = majburan.
explanation.ru: zogʻora non = кукурузный хлеб; tugun = узелок; nochor = вынужденно.
explanation.en: zogʻora non = corn bread; tugun = a bundle; nochor = reluctantly.

choices.uz: Mehnat bilan topilgan narsa qadrli va shirin boʻladi
choices.ru: То, что добыто трудом, ценно и сладко
choices.en: What you earn by work is precious and sweet
It is better to lie idle
It is better to throw the bread away

prompt.en: What lesson do we draw from the tale?

explanation.uz: Mehnat bilan topilgan narsa eng qadrli va shirin boʻladi.
explanation.ru: Добытое трудом — самое ценное и сладкое.
explanation.en: What is earned through work is the most precious and sweet.

openEnd.uz: Sen oʻzing mehnat qilib erishgan narsang bormi? Qanday his qilgansan?
openEnd.ru: Есть ли что-то, чего ты добился своим трудом? Что ты чувствовал?
openEnd.en: Is there something you achieved by your own effort? How did it feel?

clue.en: The wise line from the tale

prompt.en: Complete the sentence with the right word!

explanation.uz: Mehnat bilan topilgan non shakardan shirin.
explanation.en: Bread earned by work is sweeter than sugar.

prompt.en: Build the word from the syllables!

explanation.uz: meh-nat → mehnat. Non ham, baxt ham mehnatdan.
